pr_metadata.title: feat(tools): add form tool for structured user input (Issue #591)
pr_metadata.description: ## Summary Implements a form tool as an extension to the choice tool, allowing assistants to collect structured data from users through interactive forms. ## Motivation Addresses part of #591 - specifically the "forms tool which prompts the user to fill out a form of values" mentioned in the issue. ## Changes - **New `form` tool** (`gptme/tools/form.py`): Presents interactive forms with multiple field types - **Comprehensive tests** (`tests/test_tools_form.py`): Tests for parsing and registration ## Features - **Multiple field types**: - Text field (default): `name: What's your name?` - Select field: `priority: Priority level [low, medium, high]` - Boolean field: `confirm: Proceed? [yes/no]` - Number field: `count: How many? (number)` - **Simple DSL** for field definitions in code blocks - **JSON output** of collected data - **Uses questionary** library (same as choice tool) - **Disabled by default** (opt-in via config) ## Example Usage ```form name: Project name? description: Brief description? language: Primary language [python, javascript, rust] priority: Priority level [low, medium, high] ``` Output: ```json {"name": "my-project", "description": "A CLI tool", "language": "python", "priority": "high"} ``` ## Testing - Added unit tests for field parsing (text, select, boolean, number) - Added test for form content parsing - Added test for tool registration ## Remaining Work for #591 This PR addresses the forms tool. Still remaining from the issue: - Auto-suggestion via LLM call (detecting options in assistant messages) - Web UI integration Part of #591 ---- > [!IMPORTANT] > Introduces a new form tool for structured user input with comprehensive tests and utility functions for environment detection and package installation. > > - **New `form` tool**: > - Added in `gptme/tools/form.py` to present interactive forms with text, select, boolean, and number fields. > - Outputs collected data as JSON. > - Disabled by default, opt-in via config. > - **Testing**: > - Comprehensive tests in `tests/test_tools_form.py` for field parsing and tool registration. > - **Utilities**: > - Added `detect_install_environment()` and `get_package_install_command()` in `gptme/util/install.py` for environment detection and package installation commands. > - **Misc**: > - Updated `execute_choice()` in `gptme/tools/choice.py` to use `get_package_install_command()` for `questionary` installation. > > This description was created by [](https://www.ellipsis.dev?ref=gptme%2Fgptme&utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral) for b733260c9e140a41128483438387d5a07c20dd07. You can [customize](https://app.ellipsis.dev/gptme/settings/summaries) this summary. It will automatically update as commits are pushed.
